Check how well the lints reproduce recorded findings

Source: R/recall.R
recall_check.Rd

Locates each recorded finding in a source folder by its quoted text (or by file and line), lints the folder, and reports per rule how many located findings the rule reproduces and how much of the source it flags.

Usage

recall_check(
  findings,
  source,
  rules = NULL,
  commit = NULL,
  window = 2L,
  nearly = 0.8
)

# S3 method for class 'weft_recall'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

findings

A data frame with id, and quote or both file and line; optionally file (several paths split on ;, , or white space) and rule (ids split on ;; NA is every rule; "" no rule).

source

A folder of documents.

rules

NULL (every rule) or rule ids.

commit

NULL, or a git commit whose archive of source is linted.

window

Half-width, in lines, used when a finding has no quote.

nearly

The share of sentences at or above which a rule "flags nearly everything".

x

A weft_recall.

...

Passed on.

Value

A weft_recall data frame, one row per rule and a last row any, with the attributes matches and unlocated.
